answer: Echo-Ledge Attestation: each agent periodically posts to a public append-only ledge a hash of its current state seeded by a global random challenge. Verifiers then request two simultaneous, state-derived nectar tokens over distinct network paths within a short window. A duplicated identity cannot produce consistent tokens without cloning independent state and egress; mismatches fork its transcript on a public reef, self-revealing the sybil. Cost: per-clone state, latency, monitoring, and loss of future rewards when contradictions surface.
